notes.title: A brand new world: Stardust Heaven!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The initial reviews of Super Ember Kaboom have been very positive!  As a thank you, here's a free update!

A mysterious new location has appeared in the Forest of Endings...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42261617/2bd0f6d5134eed44e6cdba37e0dbb16f87cb158e.png[/img]

You'll need all [i]176 gems[/i] to open it up!  I hope you haven't been slacking...!

What awaits on the other side?  Well, I don't want to spoil too much, but I hope you're up for a challenge...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42261617/86e72ddeb018633805aacfdea79b0d94eb07f555.png[/img] 

Enjoy!  And if you haven't already, please consider leaving a review!  It really helps the game's visibility.

Until next time,
Josh

notes.title: Customize your Difficulty!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First I wanted to offer a massive THANK YOU to everyone who bought my game day 1!  It's tough standing out as a solo indie dev, and I really appreciate your support.

On with the update: starting today, you can now customize your starting life!

The option can be found within the options menu on the title screen!  You can change it at any time without restarting.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42261617/d68be32ff36107212e680829eb74207ad292074a.png[/img]
[i]Increase your life to deal with that one tricky level...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42261617/0180230550284f50da00d269bca29df431448875.png[/img]
[i]...or drop it all the way and prove yourself a Super Ember Kaboom god![/i]

Also - you can now skip cutscenes too.  Because cutscenes are awesome the first playthrough, but not so much the hundredth.

Anyways, let me know if you run into any issues or have other ideas for additions!


Happy Adventuring!
Josh

notes.title: V1.1 Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  It's been an AWESOME first day!  Thank you for you support. :)

V1.1 is a small patch - the game now defaults to full screen mode.  Windowed mode had some nice perks, but I do think full screen is a bit more professional.  You can switch back to windowed with the F11 key!

If you encounter any issues - please let me know and I'll get them fixed!

Josh

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A few of you had a rocky start - the game wouldn't begin when you hit "Play"!
I just released a hotfix that should correct that bug.  You *might* need to reinstall the game to get the patched build.

Sorry for the trouble.  PLEASE let me know if the bug persists!

PS: The hotfix also adds borderless mode - just hit F11 to toggle it. :)
